kicad_symbol_check: pins 1 A1, 2 A0, 3 ALERT, 4 SDA, 5 SCL, 6 VS, 7 GND, 8 VBUS, 9 IN-, 10 IN+ match ds p3

circuit.role: shunt for +-3 A, ADCRANGE=1 (+-40.96 mV): full scale +-4.1 A, 1.25 uV/LSB = 125 uA, 90 mW at 3 A
input series resistors (protect against fast edges up to the 40 V differential rating; keep <= 100 ohm)
clamp at the probe terminals to stay inside 85 V / -0.3 V: bidirectional TVS sized for the intended range [this design, part not chosen]

logic: SDA/SCL tolerate 6 V whatever VS is (p3); 3.3 V bus direct

i2c_addr.bus: I2C_U (proposed; I2C_S also free of clashes)
i2c_addr.select: A1/A0 each to GND, VS, SDA or SCL: 0x40-0x4F; GND/GND = 0x40 (p17 table 7-2)

placement: Shunt next to the probe contacts with Kelvin connections; heavy copper for 3 A.
Probe contacts: I+ / I- (in-line) and the bus voltage is taken at I- (load side).
notes: Common-mode range -0.3..+85 V at IN+, IN- and VBUS (p4-5), differential abs max +-40 V (p3): high-side or low-side sensing both work; the limit is the NEGATIVE side (-0.3 V), so a reversed probe needs the clamp/series resistors.
Alternative: 50 mohm with ADCRANGE=0 (+-163.84 mV, +-3.28 A) gives 4x the signal but 0.45 W and 150 mV burden at 3 A.
